title: Dualiso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Dualiso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dualiso is a lightning-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Vitality (S), Defense (A).

sections.title: How to Get the Dualiso
sections.content:
Location: Forgotten Battlefield - defeat Dualliste.

Obtained from Forgotten Battlefield - defeat Dualliste.

sections.title: Is the Dualiso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (S), Defense (A). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
